notes.title: Patch Notes #3 (The Lingering) Graveyard Visit
notes.content:
Hi everyone,
We’ve just pushed out another small update aimed at improving polish, clarity, and overall player experience. Thank you again for all the thoughtful feedback and support. It really means the world to our small team.

[b]Bug Fixes & Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fence Collision Fixes
Improved collision handling on several fences to prevent unintended movement issues and improve exploration flow.
[*] New: Disclaimer Page
Added a brief disclaimer screen at the start of the game to provide context and content warning, ensuring a more informed experience for players.
[*] Dialogue Polish
Refined and adjusted dialogue timing, formatting, and presentation for better pacing and immersion during key story moments.[/list]

If you notice anything else while playing, don’t hesitate to drop us a note on the Steam Community Hub or via socials. Your feedback helps us keep improving!

[i][b]—Storytale Team[/b][/i]

notes.title: Patch Notes #1 20/06/2025
notes.content:
Hi everyone,
We’ve just released a small patch to fix a few bugs and improve the overall experience. Thank you for all the feedback and reports, it’s been incredibly helpful.

[b]BUILD VERSION 1998[/b]

[b]Fixes and Improvements:[/b]

[b]Steam Achievement Fix[/b]
Resolved an issue where some achievements were not unlocking as intended.

[b]Collision Bug – Blue Tarp Area[/b]
Fixed a collision problem near the blue tarp that could cause players to clip through or get stuck.

[b]Dialogue System Update[/b]
Dialogue no longer auto-advances. It will now progress when clicked, allowing you to control the pacing.

[b]Lamp Switch Interaction[/b]
Increased the hitbox size for the lamp trigger switch to make it easier to interact with.

We appreciate your continued support. If you encounter any issues, feel free to report them through the Steam Community Hub.

Storytale Team

notes.title: NEW EPISODE OF THE LINGERING SERIES!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32810808/7b366fe0261dded380f34a474694224ad5a363c3.gif[/img]

[i](The Lingering)[/i] is an episodic atmospheric horror series, inspired by true horror events and urban legends in Indonesia. Each episode tells the unsettling stories of those who cross paths with the lingers.

[h2]THE STORY[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32810808/6875a94abc6b0a4174a4bbc24161f76b93d6f5fa.gif[/img]

In [i](The Lingering) Graveyard Visit[/i], play as Eki, an 11-year-old boy visiting his late father’s grave with his mother. There, he meets Tomy, a local boy who seems to know a lot about the village—including the dark rumors surrounding the sacrificial ritual, a wealth-seeking ritual said to involve sacrificing a child…

Haunted by doubt, Eki begins to suspect that this graveyard visit might be somewhat related to the ritual, especially knowing his mother has been struggling financially since his father’s death.

[h2]Are you brave enough to seek out the truth?[/h2]
